_comment: Add the contents of 'mcpServers' into your existing Claude Desktop config at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Fill in the API keys and update the path to match where you cloned this repo.

woolworths-nz._comment: Custom Woolworths NZ server — run 'npm install && npm run build' first

gmail._comment: Gmail via OAuth. Run 'npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp' once in your terminal to complete the OAuth flow, then it stores tokens automatically.

todoist._comment: Official Todoist MCP — get your API token at todoist.com/app/settings/integrations/developer

brave-search._comment: Web research for todo tasks. Get a free API key at brave.com/search/api/
